entries.title: Hebrews 10:1
segments: For the Law, being only a shadow of the good things to come, and not their very substance, its priests cannot with the same sacrifice which year after year they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:2
segments: Otherwise would they not have ceased to be offered? Because the worshippers having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:3
segments: But on the other hand, in these sacrifices sins are called to memory, year after year.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:4
segments: For it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:5
segments: It is for this reason that the Christ, on coming into the world, declared: Sacrifice and offerings thou dost not desire, But a body didst thou prepare for me;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:6
segments: In whole burnt offerings and sin offerings Thou hast taken no pleasure.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:7
segments: Then I said, "I am come--in the roll of the book it is written of me-- To do thy will, O God."

entries.title: Hebrews 10:8
segments: First when it is said, Thou hast no longing for, thou takest no delight in Sacrifices and offerings, or whole burnt offerings and sin offerings,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:9
segments: (offerings regularly made under the law), and then it is added, Lo, I come to do thy will, he does away with the first, in order that he may establish the second.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:10
segments: And it is by this will that we have been sanctified by the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:11
segments: For while every priest stands, day after day, at his ministrations, and many times repeats the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:12
segments: this Priest, after offering one Sacrifice for sins, sat down forever on God's right hand;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:13
segments: henceforth waiting until his enemies be put as the footstool of his feet.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:14
segments: For by one single offering he has perfected forever those whom he is sanctifying.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:15
segments: And the Holy Spirit also gives his testimony, when he said:

entries.title: Hebrews 10:16
segments: "This is the covenant I will make with them After those days," says the Lord: "I will set my laws upon their hearts, And I will inscribe them on their minds."

entries.title: Hebrews 10:17
segments: Then he adds, And their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:18
segments: But when these have been remitted, there is no more any offering for sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:19
segments: Since, then, we have a cheerful confidence, brothers, to enter into the Holiest by the blood of Jesus,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:20
segments: by the way which he dedicated for us, that new and living way, through the veil (that is, his flesh);

entries.title: Hebrews 10:21
segments: and since we have a great High Priest over the house of God;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:22
segments: let us draw near with a true heart, in full assurance of faith, our hearts sprinkled from and evil conscience, and our bodies bathed in pure water.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:23
segments: Let us hold fast the confession of our hope, unwavering (for He is faithful who promised);

entries.title: Hebrews 10:24
segments: and let us consider one another, to provoke unto love and good works;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:25
segments: not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as is the custom of some, but exhorting one another; all the more as you behold the Day drawing near.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:26
segments: For if we sin wilfully, after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains any other sacrifice for sins,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:27
segments: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fiery indignation which is about to devour the adversaries.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:28
segments: Any one who set at naught the law of Moses was put to death without pity, on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:29
segments: How much surer, think you, will be the punishment of one who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has profaned that covenant blood with which he was sanctified, and has done despite to the spirit of grace?

entries.title: Hebrews 10:30
segments: For we know Him who said, Vengeance is mine, I will repay, and again, The Lord will judge his people.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:31
segments: IT IS A FEARFUL THING TO FALL INTO THE HANDS OF THE LIVING GOD!

entries.title: Hebrews 10:32
segments: But ever call to mind the former days, in which, after having been enlightened, you endured a great conflict of sufferings;

entries.title: Hebrews 10:33
segments: partly by being made a public spectacle in reproaches and afflictions, and partly by sharing the fortunes of those that were so used.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:34
segments: For you did sympathize with the prisoners, and you did take joyfully the confiscation of your goods; conscious that you had for yourselves greater, even lasting possessions.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:35
segments: Now do not fling away your bold confidence, for it has a great recompense of reward.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:36
segments: For you need stedfastness, so that after having done the will of God, you may receive the promise,

entries.title: Hebrews 10:37
segments: For yet a very, very little while, and then The Coming One will have come, without delay.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:38
segments: But it is by faith that my Righteous One will live, And if he draws back, my soul takes no pleasure in him.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:39
segments: "But we are not of defections unto perdition, but of faith unto the gaining of the soul."
